tokenizer_identity: cached olmOCR 2 Qwen-family tokenizer; fixed counting reference, no added special tokens

pmc.name: PMC local biology papers
pmc.source_scope: Frozen local selected papers, not the whole PMC archive

counting_policy.text: Count original dataset text; local papers count title, selected blocks, captions/notes and tables once. Do not add chunks/interleaved copies.
counting_policy.exact_dedup: SHA256 after whitespace collapse; preserve case, punctuation and scientific strings. Fixed input order keeps first occurrence across all sources.
counting_policy.modalities: Assign each full-record token by its starting character offset to explicit protein/dna/rna/smiles/inchi content, otherwise text_or_unclassified. Tag boundaries stay in text_or_unclassified.
counting_policy.images: Preserved original assets are not vision-tokenized; image token count is unknown.
counting_policy.scope: Candidate tokens before biology/clinical selection, quality filtering and near-duplicate removal. No extrapolation to unscanned files.
